bio: Tuck into a traditional Afternoon Tea for two as you enjoy a leisurely cruise along the scenic Bridgewater Canal.  Enjoy a luxury cruise with Afternoon Tea for two aboard the Francis Egerton, exploring the Bridgewater Canal between Worsley and the Barton Aqueduct. Take in the historic sights while tucking into a glorious selection of treats during this 2 hour trip, including sandwiches, freshly baked scones, clotted cream and a variety of petits fours.
